error_report.description: Sent only when an Ashley check fails or is repaired, only if ashley.diagnostics.share is on AND VS Code telemetry is enabled AND ashley.diagnostics.endpoint is configured; at most one per distinct failure per day; a copy is kept locally (Ashley: Error reports).

install_id.comment: a random UUID made on this laptop; not derived from the person or the machine

nodes.comment: check ids, verdicts, durations; detail strings scrubbed of e-mails, AccessIDs, paths, hostnames, addresses, job ids and token-shaped strings

errors.comment: the last ERROR lines of Ashley's own log, scrubbed the same way
